phases.goal: Research all distribution channels, credentials, APIs, validations, risks.
phases.success_definition: Rig has a schema-governed research packet for distribution and release governance.

phases.goal: Distribution Operating Picture: document which channels are configured, safe, or refused.
phases.success_definition: Cockpit shows honest operating picture of all distribution channels.

phases.goal: Release Preflight: run all validation checks without any publish attempt.
phases.success_definition: Rig can audit release readiness across all channels without mutation.

phases.goal: macOS Notarization Captain: submit for notarization, poll status, staple ticket.
phases.success_definition: Rig can notarize macOS apps with receipt-backed evidence.

phases.goal: Package Registry Packets: npm, PyPI, crates.io publish in dry-run/approval-required mode.
phases.success_definition: Rig can publish packages with preflight checks across JS/Python/Rust.

phases.goal: GitHub Release & Pages Operator: create releases, upload assets, deploy Pages.
phases.success_definition: Rig can manage GitHub Releases and Pages with evidence.

phases.goal: App Store & TestFlight Packets: manage TestFlight builds and App Store submissions.
phases.success_definition: Rig can upload TestFlight builds and submit for review.

phases.goal: Google Play Packets: manage tracks, upload bundles, update listings.
phases.success_definition: Rig can manage Google Play tracks and submissions.

phases.goal: Microsoft Store Packets: manage submissions, package flights, certifications.
phases.success_definition: Rig can manage Microsoft Store submissions.

phases.goal: Provenance, SBOM & Attestation: sign with cosign, generate SBOMs, publish attestations.
phases.success_definition: Rig produces SLSA-compliant provenance and SBOMs.

phases.goal: Release Mutation Operator: automated publish decisions with approval gates and dry-runs.
phases.success_definition: Rig can execute publish actions with rollback plans.

phases.goal: Multi-Channel Release Chief of Staff: coordinate releases across all channels.
phases.success_definition: Rig orchestrates multi-channel releases with unified evidence.
